run_linear_crf_training: run the linear chain CRF training example with SGD to learn potentials and transitions
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for a CRF with given features and classes
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF negative log likelihood loss for a given input and target sequence
